class: Stale verification recovery and unsupported success classification
symptom: An unverified account remained at Sign In while the agent searched Gmail without requesting a fresh verification email; an Invalid Token page could be reported as verified.
root_cause: The verification reader had no resend step and treated absence of a recognized failure as success. Generic Welcome or Thank You text overrode invalid-token errors.
why_tests_missed: No regression exercised a rejected verification link with generic welcome text or the live resend-to-email sequence.
fix: Require a current portal verification requirement and authorized mail access. Use the visible resend control unless email dispatch is already confirmed; preserve a different owner-entered account. Reject invalid links regardless of generic greetings, require explicit verification evidence, and distinguish a sign-in landing from verified status. Live recovery requested a fresh Chipotle email, opened its link, and reached authenticated Candidate Home after sign-in.
prevention: Test observed portal outcomes rather than clicks, and cover stale-token failures, live verification prerequisites and owner identity preservation.
